entities.name: Tajamin
entities.description: A Keldon doyenne, Keeper of the Book of Keld, who taught Astor the history and philosophy of Keld.

entities.name: Astor
entities.description: A former camp runner who became one of the most famous and powerful warlords of Keld.

entities.name: Commander Treulk
entities.description: Commander under whom Astor served as camp runner.

entities.name: Olvresk
entities.description: A doyen who took Astor from Treulk and sent him to train under Tajamin, then stormed her compound.

entities.name: Jezal's Covenant
entities.description: A teaching Tajamin gave Astor after he learned the spell.

events.summary: Olvresk took Astor from Treulk and sent him to train under Tajamin.
events.quote: Olvresk took him from Treulk and sent Astor to train under Doyenne Tajamin

events.summary: Olvresk stormed Tajamin's compound with his Fists and slaughtered many of her people.
events.quote: He stormed Tajamin's compound and used his Fists, his elite soldiers, to slaughter many of Tajamin's people.

events.summary: Tajamin saved herself and Astor by telling Olvresk to teach Astor the Tinder Spell himself.
events.quote: Tajamin saved her own life, as well as that of Astor

events.summary: Astor learned the spell in two days without food, and Tajamin told him of Jezal's Covenant.
events.quote: Two days later, Astor knew the spell

events.summary: Astor rose to become one of the most famous and powerful warlords of Keld.
events.quote: Astor rose to become one of the most famous and powerful warlords of Keld in modern times.

relations.note: Taught him Keld's history and philosophy.
relations.quote: She was responsible for teaching Astor the history and philosophy of Keld.

relations.note: Disagreed with her methods and attacked her compound.
relations.quote: Olvresk disagreed strongly with these methods.
